what: `blaze explain problems build=7` and any query over `events_wide` on reth's history die in DuckDB (`Out of Memory Error .. 3.7 GiB/3.7 GiB used`); the same rows read through `events` joined to `event_values` for one message answer in seconds. redit-14 saw it for `blaze why`.
cost: each why question on reth needs a hand-written query
cause: `events_wide` pivots every event's fields before the filter
class: a view that is the size of the history, not of the answer
fix: filter by build and level before the pivot in `problems`; raise or lift the client's memory limit
